name: palimpsest
description: Local experiment runner for the Palimpsest collaborative decipherment puzzle.

scripts.check: pnpm verify:versions && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
scripts.format: oxfmt --config oxfmt.json --write README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json oxfmt.json oxlint.json vitest.config.ts src tools tests specs docs experiments fixtures/corpus/provenance.json AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md python/pyproject.toml && uv run --offline --frozen --project python ruff format --config python/pyproject.toml python
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --config oxfmt.json --check README.md package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.base.json oxfmt.json oxlint.json vitest.config.ts src tools tests specs docs experiments fixtures/corpus/provenance.json AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md python/pyproject.toml && uv run --offline --frozen --project python ruff format --config python/pyproject.toml --check python
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings src tools tests vitest.config.ts && uv run --offline --frozen --project python ruff check --config python/pyproject.toml python
scripts.test:contract:py: uv run --offline --frozen --project python pytest -c python/pyproject.toml -m contract
scripts.test:material: uv run --offline --frozen --project python pytest -c python/pyproject.toml -m material
scripts.test:unit:py: uv run --offline --frozen --project python pytest -c python/pyproject.toml -m 'not contract and not material'
scripts.verify:full: pnpm verify && pnpm test:material && pnpm test:acceptance && pnpm puzzle:sandbox:build && pnpm test:docker
